title: Central Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 — Returns
citation: CGST Act, 2017, sections 37 and 39; CGST Rules, 2017, rules 59 and 61
text: Section 37 concerns furnishing details of outward supplies. Section 39 concerns furnishing returns. Rules 59 and 61 set out the manner of furnishing outward-supply details and returns. The applicable due date can vary with registration type, return frequency, and notifications in force.

title: MSMED Act, 2006 — Delayed payments
citation: MSMED Act, 2006, section 15; Companies Act, 2013, section 405
text: Section 15 of the MSMED Act deals with the time limit for payment to a micro or small enterprise supplier. Companies covered by the reporting order must furnish specified information about outstanding payments in the prescribed form and period.

title: Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948 — Coverage
citation: Employees' State Insurance Act, 1948, sections 1(5) and 2(9)
text: Section 1(5) permits extension of the ESI Act to specified establishments. Whether coverage applies depends on the notified establishment category, applicable state notification, employee count, and wage conditions.

title: Companies Rules — Director KYC
citation: Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014, rule 12A
text: Rule 12A prescribes annual KYC by individuals holding a Director Identification Number. Check current MCA form instructions and notifications for the applicable date and fee.
